about: Dataset registry for BroccoliDetect. Each entry pins one immutable dataset version stored in the team's Azure Blob container, so every model version in backend/weights/registry.json can point back to the exact images it was trained and evaluated on. See data/README.md for the add-a-version procedure.

versions.description: RGB field images from Deliverable B: the RGB channel of the original RGB-D capture, annotated with broccoli crown bounding boxes.
versions.notes: Archived from the team's Roboflow export (workspace broccoli4b, project broccoli-4b, v1): train/valid/test splits with YOLO txt labels and data.yaml; a manifest.json with per-file SHA-256 checksums travels inside the zip. Cross-split duplicate check at archive time found no leakage. Replace the <team-storage-account> placeholder once the archive is uploaded.
